llm.summary: The supplied labels attribute the outcome to company-specific alpha while separately recording a premature-stop-noise process fault. The positive benchmark-relative result does not erase the timing failure: the position may have been stopped before the labeled alpha could mature.
llm.root_cause: The supplied labels attribute the outcome to company-specific alpha while separately recording a premature-stop-noise process fault. The positive benchmark-relative result does not erase the timing failure: the position may have been stopped before the labeled alpha could mature.
llm.lesson: The company-alpha book surfaced the opportunity, while the entry-timing and path-risk engines missed or mishandled ordinary post-entry noise.
llm.engines_credit: Company-alpha organs are the provisional role models; stop calibration and path-risk books are the laggards, although their underlying telemetry was not supplied.

causal_chain.mechanism: A company-specific mechanism reportedly supported benchmark-relative strength.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Without the company-specific alpha, benchmark-relative strength might not have appeared.

causal_chain.mechanism: Interim price noise reportedly activated the stop before the thesis could mature.
causal_chain.counterfactual: A path-aware stop treatment might have distinguished thesis impairment from transient noise.

causal_chain.mechanism: The realized path made the initial stop placement or timing incompatible with the opportunity's volatility.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Different entry timing or volatility-conditioned stop placement might have preserved exposure without changing selection standards.

alternate_explanations: A broad technology rotation could have produced the relative strength instead of company-specific alpha.
The stop may have reflected genuine thesis deterioration followed by an unrelated rebound.
A catalyst emerging after entry could explain the favorable relative outcome.
missing_evidence: Entry, stop, exit, and post-exit price path
Contemporaneous company-alpha features and thesis notes
Realized and expected volatility at entry
Dated company news and catalyst history

signal_hypotheses.feature: Post-stop recovery without contemporaneous thesis impairment
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Compare the post-stop path with the original thesis horizon and dated fundamental revisions.
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: More recoveries without thesis impairment would support volatility-conditioned stop handling.
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: Most stopped cases continue deteriorating or show contemporaneous thesis impairment.
